newsitem.title: MONACO: POPOV AND MASTERKOVA VOTED BEST IN EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: POPOV AND MASTERKOVA VOTED BEST IN EUROPE.

text.p: medalists Alex Popov and Svetlana Masterkova were voted European
sportsman and sportswoman of 1996 in a poll by the European
Sports Press Union, it was announced on Tuesday.
Swimmer Popov, who retained his Olympic 50 and 100 metres
freestyle titles in Atlanta, received 53 points, well clear of
second placed British motor racing world champion Damon Hill on
Danish cyclist Bjarne Riis, winner of the Tour de France,
was another point back in third place.
Middle-distance runner Masterkova, the 800 and 1,500 metres
Olympic champion, won the women's category with 54 points.
She was closely pressed by French 200 and 400 metres double
gold medalist Jose-Marie Perec on 49 points with Germany's world
number one tennis player Steffie Graf, last year's winner, third
